profile.summary: Protect|ED (Protect Education) is a company that sells air disinfection and purification equipment to K-12 schools. It offers NanoStrike air purification units for classrooms, athletic facilities, cafeterias and other school spaces. It describes itself as a team of healthcare, education and manufacturing professionals supporting school communities.
